title: Feature flag registry schema
description: Meta-schema that feature-flags.json must validate against. Enforced in CI.

key.description: camelCase flag key, matching the backend JSON response.

label.description: Short human-readable name shown to the operator in the admin console.

sensitivity.description: How much warning the admin UI gives before the flag is flipped. "safety" = flipping it changes what members are invited to physically drive to and stop at; "privacy" = it governs data collected about members; "standard" = ordinary product surface.

description.description: What the flag controls AND what turning it off stops — the operator reads this while deciding.
